stem: By what age have most children who develop atopic dermatitis already shown onset?
explanation: By 5 years of age is correct because most children who develop atopic dermatitis have already had onset by then.

rationale: Most cases begin in early childhood, with the large majority presenting by age 5.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because most children with atopic dermatitis have onset by 5 years of age.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because onset is usually earlier than 10 years in most affected children.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because 12 years is later than the typical age of onset.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because 15 years is later than the typical age of onset.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because 18 years is later than the typical age of onset.
